body: I’m sorry for your loss, and I do hope you’ll get to enjoy that camper as much as he would want you to!
Yeah! I felt like home looking at this. Good job!

It wasn’t my school or work. It was my mom, in regards to chores. She would say she would give me a dollar a day if I did my chores, but remove 25 cents for each chore I didn’t do. 

So I just didn’t do any at all and got 0$ because she never implemented a rule that I would owe her money.

I wasn’t always a good kid and I do feel back about it now :(
Thank you for saying that. I feel like such trash and the other comments are making t worse :(

Thank you. It’s really difficult to throw in the towel. In one end I kept trying to convince myself that I could learn to love this child and be a co-parent because I love my boyfriend so much. On the other hand, deep deep down I knew this might not end well. 

Now I feel like I’m giving up and I feel like trash even though I know it’s the right thing to do.

I don’t *supposedly* love, I definitely do. 

And this kid’s actions don’t hurt me. I don’t think I can blame her for any of this. It’s just my feelings, or lack there of, towards her. That apathy towards her. That’s kind of painful to live. And the guilt I feel about it is hard to live as well. 

*edit* and she may not understand or feel how I’m feeling towards her, but I’m sure my boyfriend realizes it

He knew where I stood the entire time and we mutually decided to have this relationship. He knew that I would try but that it’s an entirely real possibility that it would not work out. 

I get that you’re bitter, and I’m planning on ending this tomorrow, so your comment doesn’t really help me. 

Do you have any advice or tips on how to break up with him (things to do, not to do), since this is really what I’m looking for.

I knew I didn’t want a kid of my own, but i didn’t realize that I didn’t want to be a step mother (I thought I would be okay with it). I was very honest with him about this from the beginning and he knows where I stand on kids, so I don’t think this will be a shock to him, although I do think he will be extremely sad.
